text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I'm so weak it's almost laughable...!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
To work this hard and still be on a losing streak?!
Am I seriously never going to win a single race from now on?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I'm utterly ruined. Everything is painful.
I don't think I'll ever be able to get back on my feet again............
choice_data_list: First, let's rest up and recover our stamina.
Let's think up a new strategy together.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Even though I lost...
Being this kind to me, you're out of your mind..."
choice_data_list: Because I know how talented you are.
Because I know just how capable you are.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's caught in a negative spiral right now,
which is why she can't bring out her full strength.
I can't let her give up here.
choice_data_list: You can win next time. You are the Ruler, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Do you really... think you can win next time?
choice_data_list: I really, really, really mean it!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Just this once for now...
If I don't win the next one, I'm not running for a while!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I need to support her properly so she can bring out the absolute best of her abilities.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even after thinking through all those options,
it still didn't work out...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "Then let me ask you: what do you think we need to do first in order to win next time?"
choice_data_list: Let's push all stats even higher!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: So in the end, it means more training?!
choice_data_list: If you don't raise your stats, the result will be the same next time.
If you don't raise your stats, the result will be the same next time, you know.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Alriiiight...
I just have to do it, right? Fine...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looks like she's managed to get back on her feet.
Next time, I have to make sure she wins!
